title: 第13章离家出走
slug: 斗罗开局被逼入赘对象宁荣荣
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

门外，宁风致站在走廊上，听着里面传来的动静，无奈地叹了口气，伸手揉了揉眉心。

旁边的尘心双手抱胸，长剑斜斜靠在肩后，眉头微微蹙着，在宁荣荣门口站了快半个时辰了。

“风致，真的不用去劝劝？再这么下去，那丫头真要饿出毛病了。”

“不用。”宁风致摇了摇头，目光越过重重殿宇，望向远方的山门方向。

“荣荣这丫头我知道，饿的受不了，她自己会吃饭的，等她折腾几天，气头过了就好了。”

尘心沉默了片刻，指尖无意识地摩挲着剑柄上的纹路。

“风致，我知道你是为了宗门着想。”他终于还是开口，声音里带着几分不易察觉的担忧。

“可就为了拉拢一个人，用荣荣的下半生去换，真的值得吗？”

宁风致收回目光，看向这位跟随了自己几十年的老剑叔。温文尔雅的脸上，第一次露出了不容置疑的笃定。

“值得。“他的声音很轻，却很重。

“作为荣荣的父亲，我又怎么会害她。”

顿了顿，他重新望向远方，夕阳在他眼底投下一片金色的光晕。

“剑叔，实话告诉你，以那小子的天分，再加上我们的全力扶持，或许要不了十年，他就会成为封号斗罗。“

“如今武魂殿势大，我们七宝琉璃宗看似风光，实则人才凋零，后继乏力。”

宁风致的声音里带着几分沉重。

“一个三十多岁的封号斗罗，若是等他彻底成长起来，即便是唐晨回归，我们七宝琉璃宗也不惧，他对于宗门的意义有多大，我想不用我多说。”

尘心嘴唇动了动，终究没再说什么。

“我知道你心疼荣荣。”宁风致忽然开口，语气软了几分，嘴角甚至勾起一抹极淡的笑意。

“但那丫头眼高于顶，一般人她也看不上。只不过是从小让你们给惯坏了，有些小脾气，等她真见到那小子，就会明白我的良苦用心了，或许，她上赶着要嫁给对方，也不是不可能。”

说着，他自己都忍不住摇了摇头。

诶，说是为了宗门，其实，还是为了这丫头，自己算是把老脸都豁出去了。

尘心看着宁风致脸上那抹意味深长的笑容，忽然觉得自家宗主好像打的不止是拉拢人才这一个算盘。

“行吧。”他叹了口气，长剑微微震颤，发出一声轻鸣。

“能让你这么推崇，那小子应该也差不到哪去。等人过来，我再验验成色，如果人品不行，说什么，我也不会让荣荣嫁给这种人。”

宁风致却只是笑，目光重新落回那条延伸向远方的大道上。

夕阳西下，金光铺满了整条山路。

他在等。

等那个能改变七宝琉璃宗未来的人。

三天后。

宁荣荣把自己关在房间里已经整整四天了。

桌上的点心换了一批又一批，从精致的桂花糕到她最爱的芙蓉酥，她连碰都没碰一下。

侍女们端进来的热茶，凉了又热，热了又凉，最后全都原封不动地端了出去。

“小姐，您就吃点东西吧，这样下去身子会垮的。”侍女站在门口，声音里带着哭腔，眼眶红红的。

“就不吃！”宁荣荣的声音从里面传出来，带着几分赌气的倔强，只是那声音明显比几天前虚弱了不少。

“除非爸爸取消婚约，不然我宁愿饿死在这里！”

侍女还想说什么，里面又是传来一阵打砸的声音。

她叹了口气，端着凉透的点心盘子，默默地退了下去。

房间里乱糟糟的。

一个小女孩就着坐在床上的角落里，双手抱着膝盖，腮帮子鼓鼓的，眼眶红红的，像是刚哭过。精致的小脸上没什么血色，嘴唇也有些发干。

她已经好几天没出门了。

这段时间，爸爸一次都没来过。

别说劝了，连问都没问一句。

就好像她这个女儿绝食，跟他一点关系都没有一样。

“咕——”

肚子不合时宜地叫了起来。

宁荣荣小脸一垮，伸手揉了揉咕咕叫的肚子。这几天，藏在床底下的零食也快吃完了，要是爸爸再不来，自己真的要饿死了……

“混蛋爸爸！”宁荣荣咬着嘴唇，眼泪在眼眶里打转，“真的不管我了吗？”

“可我真的不想嫁给一个老男人啊！”

一想到要跟一个比自己大十岁、素未谋面的人过一辈子，宁荣荣就觉得委屈。

Outside the door, Ning Fengzhi stood in the corridor, listening to the noise coming from inside, he sighed helplessly and stretched out his hand to rub his eyebrows.

Next to her, Chen Xin stood with her arms crossed, her sword leaning on her shoulder, her brows slightly furrowed, and she stood at Ning Rongrong's door for almost half an hour.

"Fengzhi, you really don't need to persuade her? If this continues, that girl will really get hungry and go into trouble."

"No need." Ning Fengzhi shook his head and looked across the palaces to the mountain gate in the distance.

"I know this girl Rongrong can't stand it when she's hungry. She knows how to eat by herself. It'll be fine after she's been struggling for a few days and her anger has passed."

Chen Xin was silent for a moment, his fingertips unconsciously rubbing the lines on the sword hilt.

"Fengzhi, I know you are thinking about the sect." He finally spoke, with a hint of unnoticeable worry in his voice.

"But just to win over one person, is it really worth spending the rest of Rongrong's life?"

Ning Fengzhi withdrew his gaze and looked at the old swordsman who had followed him for decades.For the first time, unquestionable determination appeared on his gentle face.

"It's worth it." His voice was soft but strong.

"As Rongrong's father, how could I harm her?"

After a pause, he looked into the distance again, the setting sun casting a golden halo in his eyes.

"Uncle Jian, to tell you the truth, with that kid's talent and our full support, he may become a titled Douluo in less than ten years."

"Now that the Wuhun Palace is gaining momentum, our Qibao Glazed Sect may appear to be prosperous, but in reality our talents are withering and our successors are weak."

Ning Fengzhi's voice was a little heavy.

"For a titled Douluo in his thirties, if he fully matures, even if Tang Chen returns, our Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Sect will not be afraid. I don't think I need to say more about how much he means to the sect."

Chen Xin's lips moved, but in the end he said nothing more.

"I know you feel sorry for Rongrong." Ning Fengzhi suddenly spoke, his tone a little softer, and even a faint smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.

"But that girl's eyes are higher than her head, and most people don't look down on her. It's just that she has been spoiled by you since she was a child, and she has a little temper. When she really sees that boy, she will understand my good intentions. Perhaps, it is not impossible for her to rush to marry him."

As he said this, he couldn't help but shake his head.

Hey, he said it was for the sake of the sect, but actually, it was for this girl that he risked his life.

Chen Xin looked at the meaningful smile on Ning Fengzhi's face, and suddenly felt that his sect leader seemed to be planning more than just recruiting talents.

"Okay." He sighed, the sword trembled slightly and made a soft sound.

"If you can admire him so much, that boy shouldn't be much different. When someone comes over, I will test his quality. If his character is not good, no matter what, I will not let Rongrong marry such a person."

Ning Fengzhi just smiled, and his eyes returned to the avenue extending into the distance.

As the sun sets, golden light covers the entire mountain road.

He is waiting.

Waiting for the person who can change the future of Qibao Glazed Sect.

Three days later.

Ning Rongrong had locked herself in the room for four full days.

The snacks on the table changed batch after batch, from the exquisite osmanthus cake to her favorite hibiscus cake, she didn't even touch it.

The hot tea brought in by the maids was cooled and hot, hot and cold, and finally all was brought out intact.

"Miss, just eat something, you will collapse if you continue like this." The maid stood at the door, with a crying sound in her voice and her eyes were red.

"I won't eat!" Ning Rongrong's voice came out from inside, with a bit of anger and stubbornness, but the voice was obviously much weaker than a few days ago.

"Unless dad cancels the engagement, I would rather starve to death here!"

The maid wanted to say something else, but there was another sound of smashing inside.

She sighed, holding the cold dessert plate, and retreated silently.

The room was in a mess.

A little girl was sitting in the corner of the bed, holding her knees with her hands, her cheeks bulging and her eyes red, as if she had just cried.There was no color on her delicate little face, and her lips were a little dry.

She hasn't left the house for several days.

During this time, my father never came once.

Not to mention persuading, I didn’t even ask.

It was as if her daughter's hunger strike had nothing to do with him.

"Gu——"

My stomach growled at an inappropriate time.

Ning Rongrong's face fell, and she reached out to rub her growling stomach.In the past few days, I have almost finished the snacks hidden under the bed. If my father doesn't come, I will really starve to death...

"Asshole dad!" Ning Rongrong bit her lips, tears welling up in her eyes, "Do you really not care about me?"

"But I really don't want to marry an old man!"

Ning Rongrong felt aggrieved at the thought of spending her whole life with a person who was ten years older than herself and whom she had never met before.
